faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Where do fortune cookies originate historically?
faq.a1: While popularized in early 20th-century California Chinese restaurants, their culinary precursors trace to 19th-century Japanese temple confectioneries known as tsujiura senbei, which folded paper fortunes into roasted wafers.
faq.q2: Why do fortune cookie messages feel so resonant and personal?
faq.a2: This feeling stems from psychological priming and the Barnum-Forer effect. Broad, optimistic statements encourage your mind to identify relevant personal circumstances and positive opportunities in daily life.
faq.q3: How should daily fortunes and lucky numbers be used?
faq.a3: Fortune cookies are cultural entertainment and mindfulness prompts. Rather than literal predictions or gambling advice, use them for positive reflection, daily motivation, and creative inspiration.
faq.q4: Is my fortune opening history tracked or saved remotely?
faq.a4: No. All cookie cracking animations, daily counters, and selections run entirely in your local browser. No personal data or fortune logs are transmitted to external servers.
